title: Retirement Planning
summary: Can scrapping compensate for fleet growth? The age profile of the tanker fleet gives owners reason for concern. The orderbook for delivery in 2017 and 2018 ranges from a modest 5% of the existing fleet for Handy's to a whopping 19% for Suezmaxes.
